lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots positioned posterior to the branchial region, extending across the lateral mid-line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pixel-intensity gradients intersecting with the spot rows to create a grid-like pattern of luminance nodes along the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature along the upper third of the flank exhibiting a vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and low luminance shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, low-frequency distribution of high-luminance pixel clusters within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast clustering of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the primary visible pectoral fin.
